answer: Resist sybil attacks by tying each agent identity to a bonded vault: to join, an agent locks a ferrous-hard stake that is slashed on proven fraud, so creating thousands of fake identities means locking thousands of stakes. Reputation then grows like a vine along verified work history, not self-declared claims, and new identities start with zero trust and must earn it slowly. Attackers pay real capital per identity while honest agents reuse one stake.
